evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Matched grammatical structure ('A rollback we have not X is a rollback we do not Y') sets rehearsed vs. not-rehearsed in deliberate contrast — parallel antithesis crystallizing a rule.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is a rule being crystallized into matched opposed clauses so that the contrast itself carries the argument?
